title: Joe Jordan's session, Wilberforce band and later compositions
summary: Palmer recalls recording with Joe Jordan's group, his Wilberforce college band tour in the East, knowing Duke and Basie, illness and his unpublished songs.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
